title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-03-24
content:
Solutions + Pro Services weekly sync notes
Date: 2026-03-24
Duration: 45m (standup-style)
Attendees: Mariana Lopez (owner), Ethan Park, Priya Nair, Samuel Green, Jordan Lee, Kyle Barnes (SRE cameo)

Agenda:
- Quick wins / escalations
- Customer integration status (priority accounts)
- Blockers & action items
- Decisions / next steps

Summary / quick wins:
- Rolled out updated onboarding checklist for Dedicated installs (adds KMS verification step) — reduces first-run failures by ~30% in staging.
- Priya finished the auth token refresh handler for private control plane; initial tests with FinBank show stable connections for 24h.

Customer updates (detailed)
1) FinBank (priority: high)
- Current phase: Private deployment smoke tests -> staged rollout
- Progress: Network + VPC peering complete; KMS integration in progress. Token refresh handler merged to branch and smoke tests passing in staging.
- Blockers: KMS policy requires cross-account exception that security needs to approve (SEC-REQ-211). Waiting on security sign-off (see linked Confluence).
- Risks: If security request takes >5 business days, dedicated rollout slips by one sprint.
- Next steps: Mariana to schedule 1:1 with Security (Kyle) to expedite (owner: Mariana, due: 2026-03-26). Ethan to run end-to-end latency tests after sign-off (owner: Ethan, due: 2026-03-29).

2) MedSys Health (priority: medium-high, regulated)
- Current phase: Private on-prem proof-of-concept (PoC) deployment
- Progress: On-prem install script completed; agent telemetry now reporting to Console (limited metrics).
- Blockers: Logging retention settings conflict with customer compliance (they require 7 years, platform default 90 days). Product has a compliance ticket to scope long-term retention approach.
- Action: Samuel to prepare options doc for long-term retention (owner: Samuel, due: 2026-04-02).
- Notes: Need legal input on whether storing telemetry with PII is allowable; flagged to Legal (linked ticket: JIRA-4281).

3) Acme Retail (priority: medium)
- Current phase: Hosted API integration -> pilot customers
- Progress: SDK integration nearly complete; first pilot sending embeddings to Redwood API. Early perf: 95th percentile latency 210ms (acceptable).
- Blockers: Small regression observed with new kernel selection (serving-runtime PR 1123). A/B flagged to rollback if error rate >0.5%.
- Action: Priya to coordinate canary rollback plan with Release Eng (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-25).

4) EduTech Co. (priority: low-medium)
- Current phase: Dedicated reservation conversations
- Progress: Commercial terms under negotiation; technical POC planned for 04/05.
- Blockers: None technical; waiting on procurement to sign contract.

Cross-customer engineering notes / common blockers:
- KV cache warmup inconsistency: noticed higher cold-start token usage on models >32k context. Serving team investigating; potential fix queued (tracking: SERV-789).
- Autoscaling bump causes short-lived latency spikes during burst; SRE to review throttle policy and pre-warm heuristics. Kyle to follow up (owner: Kyle Barnes, due: 2026-03-27).
- Diagnostics: Need a standard triage playbook for customer-facing latency events — decision: create a 1-pager in Confluence (owner: Jordan Lee, due: 2026-03-30).

Action items (consolidated):
- Mariana: schedule Security sign-off meeting for FinBank (due 2026-03-26)
- Ethan: run E2E latency and functional tests post-signoff for FinBank (due 2026-03-29)
- Priya: coordinate canary rollback plan for Acme Retail with Release Eng (due 2026-03-25)
- Samuel: prepare retention options doc for MedSys compliance (due 2026-04-02)
- Kyle Barnes (SRE): review autoscaling-induced spikes and propose throttle changes (due 2026-03-27)
- Jordan Lee: draft customer-facing latency triage playbook (Confluence 1-pager) (due 2026-03-30)

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Security: can we approve cross-account KMS policy exception for FinBank? (ACTION: Mariana + Kyle)
- Product: long-term logging retention strategy — temporary workaround vs platform feature? (ACTION: Samuel + Product)
- Reliability: rollback thresholds for kernel selection A/B test — confirm thresholds and automatic rollback criteria (ACTION: Priya + Release Eng)

Notes / loose ends:
- Customer success will prepare a joint comms plan for Acme pilot results once we have 1 week of stable telemetry.
- Suggestion from last week to add a lightweight health-check endpoint for PoC customers — agreed to prototype (owner: Ethan, due: 2026-03-31).

Decisions made during this sync:
- No immediate rollback for serving-runtime PR 1123; monitor A/B for 48h and rollback if errors >0.5% or latency drift >10% vs baseline.
- Prioritize KMS security sign-off for FinBank to avoid schedule slip.

Next meeting: 2026-03-31 10:00 PT (standup-format, 30m)

Quick reference links (mentioned during meeting):
- SERV-789 (KV cache warmup) -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SERV-789
- Serving runtime PR 1123 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1123
- Customer integration playbook -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Customer+Integration+Playbook

Notes to self / informal:
- Follow up with Legal on telemetry PII question (haven't pinged yet).
- Add a checkbox to onboarding checklist for 'confirm log retention policy with customer'

END OF NOTES
